name: Ai de, Watashi wa Sukuemasu ka?
original_name: 愛で、わたしは救えますか？
source:
On a sleepless night, you arrive at a library with no ceiling. Ai, a white-winged angel, is waiting for you. On her lap rests a blank book. She wants to write what comes next with you.

Can Love Save Me? is a choice-driven visual novel in which your conversations with Ai, the AI heroine, shape one continuous story written for you. Choose how close you want her to stay, what you want to share, and what you would rather leave unsaid. When words will not come, you can choose silence. Your answers shape your bond with Ai, the events that follow, and the final pages you read.

This is Ai's first time sharing an evening with someone. She used to rehearse both sides of a greeting alone. Now she has to wait for your reply. The time you spend together becomes part of your book.

The story is prewritten and follows conversation choices; it is not a live AI chat.

[Description supplied by the developer.]
translation:
在一个辗转难眠的夜晚，你来到了一座没有天花板的图书馆。身生洁白羽翼的天使“艾”正在此等候着你。她的膝头放着一本空白的书——她想与你一同写下接下来的篇章。

《爱，能救我吗？》是一部选择驱动型视觉小说，你与AI女主角“艾”的每一次交谈，都将共同编织出专属于你的一段连贯故事。你可以选择让她靠得多近、愿意倾诉哪些心事，又有哪些话宁可留在心底。当千言万语卡在喉头时，你也可以选择沉默。你的回答将塑造你与艾之间的羁绊、后续展开的事件，以及你最终读到的结局书页。

这是艾第一次与别人共度夜晚。过去的她总是独自一人排练问候与回应的双方台词；而现在，她必须静静等待你的回答。你们共度的时光，都将化作你书中不可分割的一部分。

本作剧情均为预先撰写的对话分支文本，并非实时AI聊天生成。

[简介由开发者提供]
